name: Alleppey Backwater Cruise
description: Shikara boat ride through palm-fringed backwater canals. Village visits, bird watching, sunset on water.

name: Munnar Tea Plantation Trek
description: Guided trek through world's highest tea plantation. Sunrise views, tea factory visit, tasting session.

name: Kathakali Performance
description: Traditional Kerala dance-drama performance. Elaborate makeup, expressive storytelling, live orchestra.

name: Periyar Wildlife Safari
description: Boat safari in Periyar Tiger Reserve. Elephant herds, bison, bird watching in tropical forest.

name: Kovalam Surfing Lesson
description: Beginner surfing lesson with certified instructor. Board rental, safety briefing, wave practice.

name: Chinese Fishing Net Cooking Demo
description: Learn to cook fresh catch from Chinese fishing nets. Traditional Kerala seafood preparation with local family.

name: Wayanad Chembra Peak Trek
description: Trek to Chembra Peak with heart-shaped lake. Cloud forests, panoramic views, moderate difficulty.

name: Kerala Sadya Feast
description: Traditional vegetarian feast served on banana leaf. 20+ dishes, authentic preparation, cultural significance explained.

name: Varkala Cliff Paragliding
description: Tandem paragliding over Varkala cliffs and Arabian Sea. 15-minute flight, professional instructor, GoPro footage.

name: Athirappilly Waterfall Trek
description: Trek to 'Niagara of India' waterfall. Rainforest trail, swimming in natural pool, photography spots.

name: Theyyam Ritual Watching
description: Witness ancient Theyyam ritual dance. Elaborate costumes, fire rituals, trance performances in temple courtyard.

name: Marari Beach Cycling
description: Coastal village cycling tour. Fishermen villages, coconut groves, beachside stops, local interactions.

name: Spice Plantation Tour
description: Guided walk through cardamom and pepper plantations. Learn spice cultivation, taste fresh spices, buy organic products.

name: Kochi Biennale Art Walk
description: Contemporary art exhibition in heritage buildings. International artists, installations, guided commentary.

name: Bamboo Rafting at Kuruva Island
description: Bamboo raft ride through forested river island. Untouched nature, rare birds, picnic spots.

name: Kalaripayattu Martial Arts Show
description: Ancient Kerala martial arts demonstration. Sword fighting, fire rituals, acrobatic moves, 3000-year-old tradition.

name: Sunset at Kanyakumari
description: Watch sunset over confluence of three oceans. Vivekananda Rock memorial, colorful skies, peaceful atmosphere.

name: Ayurvedic Massage
description: Traditional Kerala ayurvedic massage with medicated oils. Rejuvenation therapy, steam bath, herbal treatment.

name: Tea Museum Visit
description: Learn tea processing from leaf to cup. History of Munnar tea, machinery museum, tea tasting session.

name: Village Life Experience
description: Live with local family in backwater village. Canoe fishing, coir making, Kerala cooking lesson, paddy field walk.

name: Elephant Sanctuary Visit
description: Ethical elephant care center. Bath elephants, feed them, learn about conservation. No riding.

name: Houseboat Cooking Class
description: Learn Kerala fish curry and appam preparation on houseboat. Fresh backwater fish, coconut-based recipes.

name: Edakkal Caves Exploration
description: Trek to prehistoric cave with 6000-year-old petroglyphs. Rocky climb, ancient carvings, panoramic views.

name: Shikara Ride at Kollam
description: Peaceful canoe ride through Ashtamudi Lake's 8-channel backwaters. Mangrove tunnels, bird watching, village life.

name: Jew Town Antique Shopping
description: Browse antique shops in historic Jewish quarter. Spice markets, synagogue visit, colonial-era artifacts.
